scientific_integrity: Exact combinatorial proof and explicit marginal-preserving coupling. No external independent review has been conducted; source dates distinguish motivating 2025 work from a later 2026 comparison.
scientific_limitations: Only iid homogeneous orientation biases on simple cycles. General graphs and vertex-dependent biases are not covered; finite checks complement, but do not replace, the analytic proof. An equivalent earlier formula may exist in cyclic-runs or transitive-coupling literature.
title: Exact optimal tree coupling and two sparse-bias thresholds on cycles
